title: NEXY round 14B — revision provenance storage
scope: DOC-C §4.2/§9.6 revision created_at + created_by storage and migration proof
actions: Proved Revision storage lacked createdAt/createdBy required by canonical artifact-history responses.
Proved createdTick is deterministic monotonic time and cannot serve as wall-clock created_at.
Added fail-closed migration guard for legacy rows whose provenance cannot be reconstructed honestly.
Added rollback SQL and pinned the migration proof manifest to the pre-migration schema SHA.
Corrected an initial VAULT->CORE dependency violation by making createdAt caller-supplied.
Updated migration-proof contract to the new latest migration without weakening any gate.
unresolved: Canonical GET /api/artifacts/:id/revisions route not yet implemented.
Legacy environments containing revisions need authoritative provenance remediation before this migration can apply.
Vault commit bridge, incident detail, audit-log browsing remain open.
